name: coffLoader
description: Load a TeamServer-managed COFF/BOF tool artifact and execute an exported function.

args.name: coff_file
args.description: COFF/BOF tool artifact from Tools compatible with the current session.

args.name: function_name
args.description: Exported function to execute, usually go.

args.name: packed_arguments
args.description: Optional COFF argument format and values.
